title: Where your data is processed
description: Your notes, recordings, photos and documents go to AI models only at providers the cooperative's administrator has cleared for private data (within the limits the server operator set). If no provider is cleared for a feature, that feature is off: nothing goes anywhere else.
loadFailed: The list could not be loaded.
idle: Cleared, but not processing your data at the moment.
none: No provider is cleared for private data: AI features on your data are off.

purpose.PII_SCRUB: removing personal data from texts before sharing
purpose.PROMOTION: preparing a draft article from your notes
purpose.VLM: describing photos and checking photos before they go to the atlas
purpose.EMBED: searching notes and the wiki (text vectors)
